title: Pydantic AI: Setup Commands
description: Installation and model pulling commands for Pydantic AI with Ollama, plus banner suppression.

steps.description: All four setup commands for the Pydantic AI environment.
Pip install: pydantic-ai-slim with openai and mcp extras, plus fastmcp.
Model pulling: llama3.2 for general use, qwen2.5:3b recommended for tool steps.
Banner suppression: PYDANTIC_AI_NO_BANNER=1 hides the startup banner.
